title: US Carries Out Limited Strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island as Vance Says Talks Continue
dek: U.S. officials called the strikes defensive and aimed at missile sites, the first attacks since early September, as Netanyahu pressed for more strikes after the midterms.
author: Meridian Newsroom

image.alt: Aerial view of the Strait of Hormuz

keyPoints: The U.S. military carried out limited strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island on Monday, three U.S. officials told CNN, describing them as defensive and meant to protect U.S. assets in the region.
Iranian state television reported explosions on Qeshm Island, according to the Associated Press and Al Jazeera.
Vice President JD Vance said Monday the administration still believed a negotiated settlement was possible, and that Vance had sent a letter last week to Iran's security chief, Mohsen Rezaei.

body:
The U.S. military carried out limited strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island on Monday, Nov. 2, U.S. officials said, in what they described as a defensive action against Iranian missile capabilities in the Strait of Hormuz.

## The strikes

Three U.S. officials told CNN the strikes were limited and meant to protect U.S. assets in the region. The New York Times reported that American officials described the action as a small-scale defensive measure against Iranians accused of planning missile strikes against U.S. forces. Iranian state television reported explosions on Qeshm Island, Al Jazeera reported.

The Associated Press reported that the strikes appeared limited, rather than a return to full hostilities, and came after President Donald Trump had said the U.S. would not launch new strikes on Iran before Tuesday's midterm elections. The AP also reported that the Trump administration was last known to have carried out attacks in early September.

## Diplomacy

Vice President JD Vance told reporters Monday that "we've had a number of good conversations with the Iranians" and that he and the president felt "pretty good" about the prospects for a negotiated settlement, AP reported. Vance sent a letter last week to Iran's security chief, Mohsen Rezaei. The White House has offered few details of the letter, and Trump told reporters it focused on helping Iran with "medical supplies and various things," AP reported.

## Israel's position

AP reported that Netanyahu has urged the U.S. to carry out another round of strikes on Iran, including after the midterms. The Guardian reported that the strikes were aimed at missile batteries from which Iranian attacks on U.S. planes had been launched the day before.

## Context

Thousands of U.S. troops remain in waters off Iran to maintain a naval blockade on tankers carrying Iranian oil, according to AP, and a third aircraft carrier and additional troops are heading to the region. Meridian's earlier report on the Doha talks covers Iran's proposal to reopen the strait.
